description: SimtalkClaude injection — verifies basis.loadObjectAs is called with the right path shape and flags. Path quoting must be escaped.

tasks.name: loadObjectAs is called BEFORE changeport (Lifeline L1 ordering)
tasks.notes: mock_call_sequence is a list; two ExecuteSimTalk calls must appear with the inject one (basis.loadObjectAs) first. The grader checks this via the full sequence recorded.

tasks.name: pslib path with double-quote is escaped before injection
tasks.notes: This task verifies the script does not crash on paths containing double-quote characters. The path is added to extra_mock_paths so the isfile stub treats it as existing; the test then asserts the script proceeded past the file check.
